_doc: Hand-curated prompt inputs for tools/illustrate.py. Per character: identity (fixed anchor repeated verbatim in every range), setting (replaces the wuxia murim phrase for non-murim characters), framing, age/build/eyes/expression as a string (fill-in) or {text, basis} (basis = Korean quote), fill_ins (hair, clothing, motif), avoid (extra Avoid terms), continuity (what stays the same as an EARLIER range), skip (reason; no image). Per-range overrides are keyed by range start. A range may use only its own profile line plus non-spoiler basics; never a later range.
_notes: Techniques adopted (see the tools/illustrate.py docstring): labeled spec in the Codex imagegen order, passed verbatim; one fixed identity anchor per character; numeric apparent age; concrete un-idealized features plus Avoid terms instead of 'ugly'/'ordinary'; explicit iris colour; explicit framing and 4:5 orientation; text-only style anchoring.

Jeok Cheongang build: ch505 says 탄력 있는 근육으로 이루어진 단단한 체구와 칠 척에 달하는 키 and 40대 중후반으로 보이는 몸짱 중년인 (tall, firm and muscular, looks mid-to-late forties); the profile line's 'small and slight' is wrong for 505-710. Later ranges say small again (ch795 왜소한 체구; ch972 a disciple 3-4 heads taller), so build is per range, not part of the identity anchor.
Team Leader Choi from ch830: the scars and lost arm are a vision of an apocalyptic future (ch830, 종말), not a lasting change, so the range is skipped.
Human Butcher: the ch9 range start is a false hit (인간 백정 there is an epithet for Jin Wikyung); the character 인도 (人屠) appears at ch160. 'Butcher' is a nickname for how he kills, not a trade.
Jin Wikyung: 꺼질 듯한 눈동자 (ch21) is grief while identifying dead children, not a lasting trait; rendered as heavy, weary eyes.
